changelog:
**Added safety notices for skill commands that affect live social media accounts.**

- Consolidated and amplified safety warnings throughout documentation to help users avoid accidental or destructive actions.
- Required platform-prefixed commands for sensitive actions (posting replies, blocking, etc.) are now explicitly documented to prevent unintended cross-platform effects.
- Clarified that, after a quick one-time browser setup, all bot actions are performed fully server-side—no ongoing browser access required.
- Removed outdated documentation files, streamlining the skill's instructions.
